fieldNotes.coords: ROSTER COORDS WERE WRONG. The roster point (44.708769, -73.453892, geocode RANGE_INTERPOLATED) landed on a small orange-roofed building in a residential block ~0.35 km SW of the plant. The actual Pactiv Evergreen plant is the large multi-building industrial campus at 74 Weed Street, centered ~44.7110, -73.4525, ~0.3 km NE of the roster point. Corrected via web research (Yelp, CMac, Breakroom job posts all list 74 Weed Street) and satellite identification of the only industrial campus matching the address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire campus is enclosed by continuous chain-link perimeter fencing - visible in every 2023/2025 Street View pass along Weed Street. Truck and dock yards (north and NW of the legacy mill buildings) are reached through gated openings in that fence. Verdict: gated. Flagged uncertain because the specific gate openings/arms could not be crisply resolved - the fence-line itself is unambiguous but no single barrier-arm checkpoint was clearly imaged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at any perimeter gate opening along Weed Street or the north access. The legacy brick office building fronts Weed Street but is not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - the campus is fence-and-gate controlled but shows no manned guard booth, implying badge/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock canopy bank on the west face of a north warehouse with ~12 trailers backed in; additional dock doors on the NE warehouse face. Total estimated ~22 across the campus (band 10-25) - flagged as an estimate; the dense legacy layout obscures some faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A large gravel/paved drop yard on the NW side holds multiple rows of parked tractor-less trailers (~20+), plus more trailers along the NE warehouse face - a substantial trailer-storage operation. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - this is a sprawling campus of many connected and separate buildings: the ~1902 legacy molded-fiber mill complex (dark roofs, center/south) plus several large modern warehouse buildings (light roofs, north).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: ~8 distinct building masses estimated across the campus - the legacy mill is many interconnected structures so the count is approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail lines run along the west edge of the campus and a spur appears to enter the property on the west side near the legacy mill; this 1902-era paper/fiber mill was historically rail-served. Flagged uncertain - spur entry into the active yard not fully confirmed in current imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located inside the City of Plattsburgh NY, surrounded by residential blocks and commercial development on Weed Street - judged Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal campus roads and the deep NW drop yard easily hold a 3+ truck queue inside the fence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~39 acres covering the full legacy mill + warehouse campus; approximate given the irregular campus boundary.
